fr.english: Embrapa: Banco de Dados de Solos do Brasil (BDSolos) / Redape
fr.translation: Embrapa : Banco de Dados de Solos do Brasil (BDSolos) / Redape

fr.english: Brazil national morphological and analytical soil-profile catalogue
fr.translation: Catalogue national brésilien des profils pédologiques morphologiques et analytiques

fr.english: The official Redape catalogue entry describes national morphological and analytical soil-profile records (BDSolos); this documentation was read without downloading raw datasets or analyzing individual farm soils.
fr.translation: La notice officielle du catalogue Redape décrit les enregistrements nationaux de profils pédologiques morphologiques et analytiques (BDSolos) ; cette documentation a été consultée sans télécharger de jeux de données bruts ni analyser les sols d'exploitations individuelles.

fr.english: Catalogue displays an Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0 label; commercial reuse clearance, file access, API authentication, measurement units, and update cadence remain unverified.
fr.translation: Le catalogue affiche une mention Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0 ; l'autorisation de réutilisation commerciale, l'accès aux fichiers, l'authentification API, les unités de mesure et la fréquence de mise à jour demeurent non vérifiés.

es.translation: La entrada oficial del catálogo Redape describe registros nacionales de perfiles de suelo morfológicos y analíticos (BDSolos); esta documentación se leyó sin descargar conjuntos de datos sin procesar ni analizar suelos de fincas individuales.

es.english: Catalogue displays an Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0 label; commercial reuse clearance, file access, API authentication, measurement units, and update cadence remain unverified.

sw.english: Brazil national morphological and analytical soil-profile catalogue
sw.translation: Katalogi ya kitaifa ya Brazili ya maumbo na uchanganuzi wa tabaka za udongo

sw.english: The official Redape catalogue entry describes national morphological and analytical soil-profile records (BDSolos); this documentation was read without downloading raw datasets or analyzing individual farm soils.
sw.translation: Ingizo rasmi la katalogi ya Redape linaeleza kumbukumbu za kitaifa za maumbo na uchanganuzi wa tabaka za udongo (BDSolos); waraka huu ulisomwa bila kupakua seti ghafi za data wala kuchanganua udongo wa shamba lolote mahususi.

sw.english: Catalogue displays an Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0 label; commercial reuse clearance, file access, API authentication, measurement units, and update cadence remain unverified.
sw.translation: Katalogi inaonyesha lebo ya Embrapa CC BY-NC 4.0; kibali cha matumizi ya kibiashara, ufikiaji wa faili, uthibitishaji wa API, vipimo, na marudio ya masasisho bado havijathibitishwa.
